grant.description: A two-milestone builder grant for a settlement adapter contract and its integration documentation.

milestones.definition: Deploy the settlement adapter contract to the test network and show one successful settlement transaction through it.

milestones.definition: Publish integration documentation covering installation, the settle and refund calls, error handling and a worked example.
milestones.title: Integration documentation published
